Token values from apps/v4/app/globals.css (light block from line 100, dark from line 144) — the SAME --primary/--primary-foreground/--destructive/--ring/--input values every prior shadcn column has resolved from, re-derived here rather than borrowed to keep this column self-contained. provenance.no-primitives-clone: primitives/ (Radix's own source) was NOT cloned into 3-source/ for this build, matching the project's standing rule that Radix is behaviour-reference only, never a style source. Every cell below that depends on Radix's INTERNAL element/ARIA wiring (structure.native-input, behavior.role, behavior.keyboard-activation, prop.required) is marked [R] and cites the linked docs (https://www.radix-ui.com/docs/primitives/components/checkbox) rather than a grep. Everything that is shadcn's OWN literal source — the className string, the tri-state proof in payments.tsx, the absence of hover/pressed/indeterminate rules — is [S].
provenance.primary / primary-fg: classes `data-[state=checked]:border-primary data-[state=checked]:bg-primary data-[state=checked]:text-primary-foreground` -> --primary :107/:150, --primary-foreground :108/:151. Same INVERSION badge.shadcn.json recorded: light is near-black on near-white, dark is near-white on near-black.
provenance.ring / ring-alpha-error: classes `focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-[3px] focus-visible:ring-ring/50` -> --ring :119/:162; `aria-invalid:ring-destructive/20 dark:aria-invalid:ring-destructive/40` — the SAME indirection-slot pattern input.shadcn.json and badge.shadcn.json used so the aria-invalid rule narrows only the alpha.
provenance.box-bg: THE LIGHT/DARK ASYMMETRY: there is NO background class at all for the unchecked/rest state in light mode (the cva string has no bg-* utility outside `data-[state=checked]:bg-primary`), so the box is genuinely transparent in light mode; `dark:bg-input/30` ADDS a translucent input-tinted fill ONLY in dark mode, compiling to `color-mix(in oklab, var(--input) 30%, transparent)` per Tailwind v4's alpha-modifier convention (the same derivation input.shadcn.json and badge.shadcn.json used for their own /NN modifiers). A resting shadcn checkbox is NOT simply 'unfilled' in both modes — it is unfilled in light and faintly filled in dark, a real asymmetry not a colour inversion.
provenance.shadow-color: class `shadow-xs` = 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05). Tailwind is not vendored in this clone; the value is reused verbatim from button.shadcn.json's already-extracted style.root.elevation rather than re-derived, matching input.shadcn.json's and select.shadcn.json's own citation of the same fact. MODE-INVARIANT — the class carries no dark: variant.
provenance.transition-props: class `transition-shadow`. The property list is [S] — checkbox.tsx transitions ONLY box-shadow, unlike input/select/badge which transition color+box-shadow together, a real narrower scope worth stating. 150ms / cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1) are Tailwind's own defaults, [R], the same unvendored-Tailwind caveat every prior shadcn column has recorded.
provenance.no-hover-no-pressed-no-indeterminate-sty: CONFIRMED ABSENCE, checked directly against the literal className string: there is no `hover:`, no `active:`, and — the real finding — NO `data-[state=indeterminate]:` class anywhere. The cva-free string keys ONLY off `data-[state=checked]`. Radix's own Indicator still renders the CheckIcon for `checked="indeterminate"` (state.indeterminate), so an indeterminate shadcn checkbox shows a checkmark on an otherwise UNSTYLED (resting-coloured) box — see the matrix doc's 'Findings'.
provenance.tri-state-proof: components/cards/payments.tsx: `<Checkbox checked={table.getIsAllPageRowsSelected() || (table.getIsSomePageRowsSelected() && "indeterminate")} onCheckedChange={(value) => table.toggleAllPageRowsSelected(!!value)} .../>` — a real, first-party citation (not merely the linked Radix docs) that `checked` accepts the literal string "indeterminate" and that a click/toggle resolves to a plain boolean.
provenance.no-group-construct: CONFIRMED ABSENCE — no checkbox-group.tsx, no CheckboxGroup export, anywhere in this clone. checkbox.mdx's own prose: 'Use multiple fields to create a checkbox list' — a documented COMPOSITION pattern, not a component capability.
provenance.no-readonly: CONFIRMED ABSENCE — no readOnly/readonly/aria-readonly reference anywhere in checkbox.tsx.
